test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following banks launched the largest staff engagement initiative called ‘Next LEAP’ to empower workforce in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The State Bank of India (SBI) launched the ‘Next LEAP’ initiative in May 2025 as part of its massive workforce empowerment and staff engagement drive.
 
• Scale: It is the largest staff engagement and training programme ever undertaken in the Indian banking sector, targeting SBI's entire workforce of approximately 2.3 lakh employees.
 
• 'Next LEAP': Focuses on direct engagement between top management and employees to ensure skill adequacy and gather ground-level feedback.
 
• 'SuPer SBI: Great to Greater': A mass training program aimed at instilling organizational pride and equipping staff with future-ready skills.
 
• Objectives: The initiative aims to enhance productivity, operational efficiency, and customer service by fostering a growth mindset and leadership potential across all levels of the bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Profile of Indian Bank:**

 
 
• **Indian Bank** was established on **August 15, 1907**, as part of the **Swadeshi Movement** to promote indigenous enterprises.
 
• The bank is headquartered in **Chennai**, **Tamil Nadu**, and has a significant presence with thousands of branches and **ATMs** across **India** and international locations like **Singapore** and **Colombo**.
 
• On **April 1, 2020**, **Allahabad Bank** was merged into **Indian Bank**, making it the **seventh-largest** public sector bank in the country in terms of **business volume**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Year 2025 Vision:**
 
 
• The **2025** target for **‘Next LEAP’** coincides with the broader national goal of achieving a **$5 trillion economy**, where public sector banks play a pivotal role in **financial inclusion**.
 
• The bank aims to achieve a significant increase in its **Net Interest Margin (NIM)** and **Return on Assets (ROA)** by the end of the **2025** financial cycle through these HR reforms.
 
 
 
• **Digital Initiatives:**
 
 
• Apart from staff engagement, the bank has introduced **‘IndOASIS’**, a comprehensive **mobile banking application**, to provide seamless **digital banking** experiences to its customers.
 
• The bank is also focusing on **RAM (Retail, Agriculture, and MSME)** sectors to drive its credit growth and support the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** initiative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **‘Next LEAP’** initiative is a response to the rapidly changing **banking landscape** in **India**, characterized by intense competition from **Private Banks** and **FinTech** companies.
 
• It emphasizes **talent management** and **succession planning**, ensuring that the bank has a steady pipeline of leaders to manage its growing **asset base**.
 
• By fostering a culture of **innovation** and **accountability**, **bank** intends to improve its **Asset Quality** and reduce **Non-Performing Assets (NPAs)** through better-trained credit appraisal teams.
